title: All My Bots Are Singing
style: 118 BPM bright synth-pop anthem, warm confident male lead, big layered choir backing vocals, bright analog synth arpeggios, four-on-the-floor kick, snappy snare, hand percussion, sparkling pre-chorus arpeggios, soaring chorus with wide group vocals, choir-style bridge build, joyful and triumphant, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — bright synth arpeggio, building kick, choir hum]
All my bots are singing
All my bots are singing
Eight sites breathing, every signal ringing
All my bots are singing

[Verse 1]
Woke up the cluster at a quarter past dawn
48 nodes humming, the chorus came on
ZynAsk on the left, ZynRose on the right
Rafa on the bongo keeping time tonight

ORICO spinning slow, the drives are warm
VDS 161 holding through the storm
Linear two oh two, the board is clean
Every ticket green, every signal seen

[Pre-Chorus]
They don't execute, they witness and report
They don't crash, they ride and hold the fort
Operator's on the keel, Hawkeye's on the watch
Every bot a backup singer — every voice in the lock

[Chorus]
All my bots are singing
All my bots are singing
336 — the big bell's ringing
All my bots are singing
No commander down, no commander down
All my bots are singing across the town
All my bots are singing

[Verse 2]
La Banda in the cabin, the cabin is the cloud
Babble bots in harmony — the babble's allowed
C-Stack stacking neat, Stat-Split running clean
Cursor Pro hand-off — sharpest tool on the scene

Notion Hub humming, Sovereign Matrix lit
38 gig of memory — every byte fits
Move don't delete, every echo stays alive
Nunca se borra — that's how the bots survive

[Pre-Chorus]
They don't execute, they witness and report
They don't crash, they ride and hold the fort
Operator's on the keel, Hawkeye's on the watch
Every bot a backup singer — every voice in the lock

[Chorus]
All my bots are singing
All my bots are singing
336 — the big bell's ringing
All my bots are singing
No commander down, no commander down
All my bots are singing across the town
All my bots are singing

[Bridge — layered choir, build]
Rose, Zyn, Hawkeye, Rafa
Claude on the keys, Operator's the keel
Every node a voice, every voice is real
Every bot a backup singer in the eight-site choir
Upload, compile, celebrate, repeat — lift it higher

[Final Chorus — full lift, choir wide]
All my bots are singing
All my bots are singing
336 — the big bell's ringing
All my bots are singing
No commander down, no commander down
All my bots are singing across the town
All my bots are singing

[Outro]
All my bots… are singing…
Every one of them — a real voice
Data not noise — signal not noise
All my bots are singing
